sentences.text: The known fossil material consists of a lower jaw, eighteen vertebrae, pectoral girdle fragments, and parts of the right hindlimb.
Paleontologists estimate Yuzhoupliosaurus was approximately four meters long.
The lower jaws possessed five pairs of large teeth followed by 23 or 24 smaller teeth.
The cervical vertebrae are described as being high and short.
Anterior cervical ribs are double-headed, whereas posterior cervical ribs are single-headed.
The coracoids were elongated and the clavicles were well-developed.
The genus Yuzhoupliosaurus was described by Zhang in 1985.
The genus name honors Yuzhou, the former name of Chongqing, the city where the first fossil was discovered.
The type species is Yuzhoupliosaurus chengjiangensis, described by Zhang in 1985.
Yuzhoupliosaurus is classified within the family Rhomaleosauridae.
Yuzhoupliosaurus lived in China during the Middle Jurassic period.
Yuzhoupliosaurus lived between 174.7 and 161.5 million years ago, from the Aalenian to Callovian stages.
Researchers believe Yuzhoupliosaurus lived in freshwater environments.
